name: Review Upgrade Moment
summary: Review an in-product upgrade request for timing, value evidence, terms, recovery, and autonomy.
description: Review or design an in-product paywall, feature gate, trial ending, quota limit, or upgrade modal around experienced value and transparent commercial terms. Use when free or trial users encounter a request to pay.
risk_reason: This skill reviews an in-product upgrade request for timing, value evidence, terms, recovery, and autonomy; it does not preselect a costly option or misstate savings and reference prices.
refuses: It does not trap user data or work, obstruct dismissal, hide renewal, or create fake deadlines.
It does not preselect a costly option or misstate savings and reference prices.
It does not initiate billing, change entitlements, or claim compliance without authorized implementation and review.

operational.latency_reason: The skill reviews an in-product upgrade request for timing, value evidence, terms, recovery, and autonomy, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
